paper_title: Bridging Cognition and Emotion Empathy-Driven Multimodal Misinformation   Detection
caption: Results of Ablation Study
model_annotation: The bar chart presents the results of an ablation study comparing the accuracy (%) of different model variants on two datasets: PHEME and PolitiFact. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 75.0 to 95.0 with increments of 2.5, while the horizontal axis lists five model configurations: "Ours", "w/o comments", "w/o text", "w/o select", "w/o emotion", and "w/o cognition". The chart is divided into two sections by a vertical dashed line, with the left side showing results for the PHEME dataset and the right side for PolitiFact. Each configuration is represented by a colored bar, with "Ours" shown in dark red, "w/o comments" in orange, "w/o text" in yellow, "w/o select" in light blue, "w/o emotion" in medium blue, and "w/o cognition" in dark blue. On the PHEME dataset, the "Ours" model achieves the highest accuracy at 89.84%, followed by "w/o select" at 88.80%, "w/o emotion" at 87.34%, "w/o cognition" at 87.17%, "w/o comments" at 86.82%, and "w/o text" at 80.10%. On the PolitiFact dataset, "Ours" again achieves the highest accuracy at 90.57%, followed by "w/o select" at 89.62%, "w/o cognition" at 87.74%, "w/o emotion" at 84.91%, "w/o comments" at 85.85%, and "w/o text" at 83.02%. The bars are arranged in the same order across both datasets, and each bar is labeled with its corresponding accuracy value. The chart visually emphasizes that the full model ("Ours") outperforms all ablated versions on both datasets, with the largest performance drop occurring when text is removed ("w/o text").
